analysis_policy.calibration_assumption: pair assignment channel stable within a packing; finite state-preparation error remains
analysis_policy.corrected_probabilities: never clip; flag any out-of-range point; >3-sigma nonphysicality blocks inference
analysis_policy.cross_edge_covariance: not used for per-edge inference or Holm; no independent-edge assumption
analysis_policy.discovery_multiple_testing: Holm familywise alpha=0.05 over all 24 edges; invalid edges receive p=1
analysis_policy.frequency_assumption: every conditional rate lies strictly inside +/-1 MHz; global aliases are unidentifiable
analysis_policy.primary_delay_requirement: all six delays; no automatic shorter-prefix fit
analysis_policy.regression: ordinary least squares with free intercept and propagated joint-calibration covariance
analysis_policy.unwrap_rule: the 3-sigma phase-innovation interval stays strictly inside the chosen +/-pi branch

cost.pause_scope: account-wide hardware spacing only; excludes the initial wait, execution, collection, queueing, calibration and other sessions' jobs
cost.primitive_scenario_scope: arithmetic only; excludes all unspecified repetition, job and queue overhead
cost.timing_status: documented primitives only; no retrieved compiled schedule or runtime quote

interpretation.acquisition_disposition: complete offline design reference; revise the delay and calibration plan before acquisition because the current interbatch pauses and retained short-coherence/drift observations do not support executing the unchanged 139-batch series
interpretation.nonedge_q1_q2: not acquired here; a separate diagnostic, outside the default cost
interpretation.phase_fit: report low-contrast, alias, nonlinearity and direction-agreement failures explicitly
interpretation.preparation: a free intercept absorbs static prep phases; drive transients may still bias a slope
interpretation.primary: effective conditional idle ZZ and matched-idle detuning differences on 24 edges
interpretation.scope: no direct active-pair cross-edge in each packing; nonedge interactions remain possible
interpretation.uncertainty: preserve same-shot pair covariance and propagate all four assignment columns

measurement.assignment_convention: A[observed_index,prepared_index]; index=2*bit_a+bit_b for canonical edge a<b
measurement.neighbor_outcome: retain all joint outcomes; report unconditional and conditioned estimates
